title: Riesz gradient of a C² function is a C¹ vector field with matching norm
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let w : ℝⁿ → ℝ be of class C², where ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) carries its standard inner product ⟨·,·⟩ and Euclidean norm. Write Dw(x) := fderiv ℝ w x, a continuous linear map ℝⁿ → ℝ with operator norm ‖Dw(x)‖. Then there is a C¹ vector field G : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ such that ⟨G(x), v⟩ = Dw(x)(v) for all x, v ∈ ℝⁿ, and ‖G(x)‖ = ‖Dw(x)‖ for every x ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 w → ∃ G : Rn n → Rn n, ContDiff ℝ 1 G ∧ (∀ x v, inner ℝ (G x) v = fderiv ℝ w x v) ∧ ∀ x, ‖G x‖ = ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖
